group.passage: It is late morning at a community care station in a quiet neighborhood. A dozen older people have had their blood pressure checked and have finished some simple exercises. Now the smell of lunch is coming from the kitchen, where volunteers are serving soft tofu, vegetables, and soup. For many of the diners, this shared meal is the best part of the week. Stations like this one began in 2005, when Taiwan's government approved a plan to set them up. Local groups run the stations, and people from the neighborhood work there as volunteers. The stations visit older people at home, call them to check on them, offer health activities, and serve meals. Their number has grown quickly, from 382 in 2005 to 1,969 in 2014 and 5,210 by late 2025. Meals are an important part of the plan, because eating well is not always easy for older people. One survey found that 98.6% of people aged 65 and over had lost some of their teeth. When chewing is hard, people may stop eating certain foods and miss important nutrients. For this reason, health officials train station cooks to choose, cut, and cook food so that it is easy to chew but still tasty. At one Taipei station, a soft tofu dish made with local tea became the star of the menu, the dish that the diners love most. Food is only half the story, however. Diners say they look forward to every visit because they can chat and laugh with friends over lunch. This matters more than ever. Taiwan became a super-aged society in 2025, with about one in five people now 65 or older. In 2026, the government plans to give more help to older people who live alone, including visits, phone calls, and meal delivery.

translation_zh.text:
現在是一個寧靜社區裡的社區照顧關懷據點，時間接近中午。十幾位長者已經量過血壓，也做完了一些簡單的運動。這時，午餐的香味從廚房飄出來，志工們正端上軟嫩的豆腐、青菜和湯。對很多用餐的長者來說，這頓一起吃的飯是一週中最開心的時光。
像這樣的據點始於 2005 年，當時臺灣政府核定了一項設立據點的計畫。據點由在地團體經營，鄰里的居民在那裡擔任志工。據點會到府關懷訪視長者、打電話問安、辦理健康促進活動，並提供餐飲服務。據點的數量成長得很快，從 2005 年的 382 處、2014 年的 1,969 處，增加到 2025 年底的 5,210 處。
餐點是這項計畫很重要的一部分，因為對長者來說，吃得好並不容易。一項調查發現，65 歲以上的人有 98.6% 掉了一些牙齒。咀嚼困難時，人們可能不再吃某些食物，因而缺少重要的營養。因此，衛生單位訓練據點的廚師挑選、切割和烹煮食材，讓食物好咀嚼又好吃。在臺北的一個據點，一道用在地茶葉做的軟嫩豆腐成了「招牌菜」，也就是長者最喜愛的那道菜。
不過，食物只是一半的原因。長者們說，他們期待每一次到據點，因為可以邊吃午餐邊和朋友聊天說笑。這一點比以往更重要。臺灣在 2025 年進入超高齡社會，現在大約每五個人就有一個是 65 歲以上。2026 年，政府計畫為獨居長者提供更多協助，包括關懷訪視、電話問安和送餐服務。
